Subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool Top-up — PO amendment & billing alignment

Hi Jacob,

Congrats on the renewal milestone — really excited to keep supporting Quantica's inference workloads. A quick note to align on the dedicated capacity add-on you requested for the next term (additional 6 GPUs as a new reserved pool). We reviewed usage patterns and recommend a burst-capable pool with a guaranteed baseline throughput.

Key asks from procurement so we can finalize the amendment and update the PO:
- Do you want the added GPUs to co-term with the existing renewal date (preferred) or to start on the amendment effective date with independent billing?
- If co-terming, we need a single amended PO referencing the existing PO number and a pro-rated charge schedule for the fractional first billing period.
- Confirm the billing contact and purchase order email for DocuSign.

I attached a draft amendment that: 1) defines the reserved pool size (6x A100-equivalent GPUs), 2) includes a 99th-percentile throughput guarantee for peak 512-token sequences (see SLA spreadsheet), and 3) two billing options (co-term pro-rate vs. standalone start-of-amendment).

Attachments: Redwood_Amendment_Draft_v2.docx; SLA-throughput-examples.xlsx; link to your current PO stub: Quantica_PO_Existing.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm co-term preference and PO reference (by EOD Thu)
- We finalize amendment text and send DocuSign for signature
- Finance (Ben) will produce the pro-rated invoice schedule if you choose co-terming

If helpful I can also schedule a 20-minute handoff with our finance and legal folks tomorrow.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman

Redwood Inference

Naomi,

Appreciate the crisp summary and the draft. A few quick clarifications from procurement:

1) Co-term is preferred — we want a single PO that covers the renewal + the top-up through our FY renewal date (2027-02-28).
2) We will need pro-rata math for the added pool for the period from amendment effective date to 2027-02-28. Can Ben provide line-item proration and an estimate today?

Jacob — thanks for the quick reply; looped in Ben (finance) and Marissa (your AE) to move this along. Answers and a concrete plan below.

1) Co-term and PO reference: we will amend QH-PO-78921 to include the additional 6 GPUs and align the renewal to 2027-02-28 as requested. Amendment will carry the same billing cadence as your current PO unless you opt to change it.

2) Proration math: Ben, can you confirm but the rough approach is: prorate the monthly committed fee for the new pool from effective_date -> 2027-02-28. Example estimate included in attached file (SLA-throughput-examples.xlsx) and a draft invoice schedule is embedded in Redwood_Amendment_Draft_v2.docx.

3) SLA specifics: the throughput guarantee in the amendment is a service-level commitment tied to operational credits in the event of sustained underperformance (>72 hours aggregated below 99th-percentile target in a 30-day window). We can surface the precise credit formula in the final amendment; legal will be cc'd in the next pass. If Quantica prefers a non-financial remedy, please flag and we can switch to priority incident handling + engineering hours.

4) Effective date: if we get signed DocuSign by end-of-day Friday (2026-12-03), earliest provisioning can start Monday 2026-12-06 (pending resource pool and capacity warm-up). We'll queue the reserved nodes and can offer temporary burst capacity earlier if you need immediate headroom (short-term on-demand rates for first week).

What I need from you to send the DocuSign: confirmation that you want the amendment to reference QH-PO-78921 and that procurement@quanticahealth.com will approve the co-term billing. Once we have that, Ben will produce the pro-rated invoice schedule and I'll push the DocuSign link.

Thanks —
